title: 第一卷 第6119章 终于突破混沌主宰圆满第一卷 第6118章 规则神枪轩辕轮回的怒火
content_zh:
四周天地时空中，大量的天蕴之气开始汇聚。
如同风暴一般席卷而来，疯狂涌入体内，转化出了大量的崭新神力，不断沉淀在气海之中。
同时……
砰砰砰。
无数的窍穴爆炸声响起。
那是诸多崭新的窍穴，再度打开。
打开的那一刻，在窍穴内部的空间中，就已经凝聚出来了一条条雏形神圣之龙。
体内的法则在裂变，规则在震动，神国在裂变，神魂在突破。
各种各样的底蕴，都在以惊人的速度而蜕变着。
神念，开始暴涨。
暴涨一千兆、暴涨一万兆、暴涨十万兆……。
无时无刻不在暴涨，不在蜕变。
这样的蜕变，持续的时间，比刚才冲击境界还多。
居然足足持续了一个时辰之久。
终于，就在某个刹那……
神魂轰然一震。
叶寒顿时就感觉到，天地时空之中，无穷的变化，无数的奥义，昔日所未曾理解，未曾接触到的东西，此刻全部涌现而来，清晰呈现于脑海之中。
一下子，就有了一种突然间思绪通畅、豁达的感觉。
“哈哈哈！”
叶寒双瞳爆睁，在此刻发出了酣畅淋漓的大笑。

圆满！
终于达到了混沌主宰圆满之境。
这一天，来得迟。
别说相对于第八层诸天，就算是和第七层诸天，黄金神国之中的那些顶级妖孽相比，突破的速度，都慢了不少。
然而，修行的路上，不在于快慢，而在于高度，在于底蕴。
踏入混沌主宰圆满之境的这一刹，叶寒就发现，自己的本尊神念，居然从“一极”
达到了“两极”
的程度。
神念……
居然翻倍了。
“舒服啊！”
叶寒喃喃道。
相对于那种终焉之主级别的高手而言，神念从“一极”
达到“两极”
，其实上并不算是一件夸张的事情。
神念一极的高手，和神念两极的高手真正大战起来，胜负也犹未可知。
生死大战，看的不仅仅是神念。
但对于叶寒而言，却意义非凡。
因为他修炼了君家的逆天秘术：至尊神念术。
如果说，之前催动至尊神念术的状态下，神念能够暴涨到五极的话。

那么此刻……
这一念间，叶寒主动催动了至尊神念术。
神念，开始了不断的攀升。
content_en:
In the surrounding space and time, a large amount of heavenly energy began to gather.
Swept across like a storm, crazily pouring into the body, transforming a large amount of new divine power, and constantly settling in the sea of ​​​​qi.
At the same time...
Bang bang bang.
Countless acupoints exploded.
Those are many brand-new acupoints that have been opened again.
The moment it was opened, embryonic sacred dragons had already condensed in the space inside the orifice.
The laws in the body are fissuring, the rules are vibrating, the Kingdom of God is fissuring, and the soul is breaking through.
All kinds of foundations are changing at an astonishing speed.
Divine thoughts began to surge.
A surge of one thousand trillions, a surge of ten thousand trillions, a surge of one hundred thousand trillions...
It is always rising and changing all the time.
This kind of transformation lasted longer than the impact of the realm just now.
It actually lasted for a full hour.
Finally, at a certain moment...
The soul was shocked.
Ye Han immediately felt that in the time and space of heaven, earth, endless changes, countless mysteries, things that he had never understood or been exposed to in the past, all emerged at this moment and were clearly presented in his mind.
All of a sudden, I felt like my mind was suddenly clear and open-minded.
"Hahaha!"
Ye Han's eyes widened and he laughed heartily at this moment.
Perfection!
Finally reached the state of perfect control of chaos.
This day came too late.
Not to mention compared to the eighth-level heavens, even compared to the seventh-level heavens and the top monsters in the Golden Kingdom, the breakthrough speed is much slower.
However, the path of spiritual practice does not depend on speed, but on height and foundation.
The moment he stepped into the realm of perfect control of chaos, Ye Han discovered that his own spiritual thoughts actually came from "one pole"
Reached the "two poles"
extent.
Divine thoughts...
It actually doubled.
"It's so comfortable!"
Ye Han murmured.
Compared to masters at the level of the Lord of the End, spiritual thoughts are from "one extreme"
Reaching the "bipolar"
, in fact, it is not an exaggeration.
A master with one level of spiritual awareness and an expert with two levels of spiritual awareness are really fighting, and the outcome is still uncertain.
A life and death battle involves more than just divine thoughts.
But for Ye Han, it was of extraordinary significance.
Because he has practiced the Jun family's heaven-defying secret technique: the Supreme Divine Thought Technique.
If we say that in the previous state of activating the Supreme Divine Sense Technique, the Divine Sense could surge to the five extremes.
So at this moment...
With this thought, Ye Han took the initiative to activate the Supreme Divine Mind Technique.
Divine thoughts began to rise continuously.
